summary: BCB Bancorp, Inc. filed an 8-K under Items 2.02 and 8.01 to report its Q1 2026 financial results and to announce a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.08 per share. The filing includes a press release and financial statements. The dividend is payable on May 20, 2026 to shareholders of record on May 6, 2026. There are no acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation elements; the filing is a routine earnings and dividend announcement by the issuer.
